name: The Luwian Pantheon
dom: the gods of the Luwian-speaking peoples of Bronze and Iron Age Anatolia and northern Syria
note: Collective hub wiring the Luwian gods (Tarhunz, Tiwaz, Arma, Runtiya, Santa, Iyarri, Maliya, Kubaba) into the regional pantheon system (Taracha).

name: The Hittite Pantheon
dom: the 'thousand gods of Hatti'; the Hittite-Hurrian state pantheon of Bronze Age Anatolia
note: Collective hub for the Hittite/Hurrian state pantheon ('the thousand gods of Hatti').

name: The Phoenician Pantheon
dom: kingship; storm; sea; healing; fertility; city-tutelary cult of Tyre, Sidon, Byblos, Carthage
note: Collective hub for the Phoenician/Punic civic gods.

name: The Mycenaean Pantheon
dom: Linear B cult; Bronze-Age Aegean religion
note: Collective hub for the Linear B cult-recipients (Pylos/Knossos), distinct from the later Olympian system; ENT_MYC_TN316 is a sub-collective.

name: The Etruscan Pantheon
dom: Etruscan religion; liver-divination; chthonic and celestial cult
note: Collective hub for the Etruscan gods.
